issues.description: setIsMounted is not defined - ReferenceError thrown repeatedly, causing hydration failure and component crash
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-8a/page.tsx, setIsMounted is called but the useState hook that creates [isMounted, setIsMounted] is either missing or the destructuring is wrong (e.g. using const isMounted = useState(false) instead of const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false))

issues.description: Hydration mismatch errors - server and client render different text content, causing entire root to switch to client rendering
issues.element: step-8a page component - likely timestamp or dynamic content rendered without suppressing hydration
issues.root_cause: Dynamic content (e.g. Date.now(), Math.random(), or similar) is being rendered during SSR and differs on the client. This is compounded by the setIsMounted bug - without isMounted guard, time-based or random content renders on server and differs client-side.

issues.description: Loading state is stuck - the before/after slider and redesigned room image never appear
issues.element: Loading steps list, before/after slider, redesigned room image
issues.root_cause: Because setIsMounted is not defined, the useEffect that would set isMounted=true and trigger the transition from loading to result state never executes successfully, leaving the component permanently in loading state.

fixes.reason: Fixes the ReferenceError: setIsMounted is not defined by properly destructuring the useState return value into [state, setter] tuple
Ensures the effect runs correctly after the useState fix; also guards against stale closure issues
